title: The Heavenly Dao Descends
next_chapter_hook: The Eye of the Heavenly Dao slowly closes, leaving only a low Dao sound echoing through the void—twenty-four chapters remain until the War of Fate begins.

text.content: Ling Yuan's investigation had barely scratched the surface before being ruthlessly suppressed by an invisible hand—the shadow behind the Imperial Capital was far vaster than he could have imagined. Yet at this moment, Chen Ji had no attention to spare for these matters. All of his spiritual sense was locked onto by a force transcending the Three Realms, as if an invisible eye were piercing through layers of void, gazing into the depths of his soul.

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly grew scorching hot, golden runes dancing frantically across the pages like living creatures. Chen Ji's brow center throbbed with intense pain, as if something were tearing apart his Mental Sea—the agony was unlike any physical wound, but a burning from the very source of fate. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently convulsed within the pages, his voice trembling: 'It has come... it has finally come!'

dialogue.content: 【The Eye of the Heavenly Dao】Insignificant chess piece, do you truly believe that stealing a fragment can free you from the destined web? Three hundred years, I have waited for this day,整整三百年。

text.content: The void suddenly tore apart. An eye emerged from the rift, its pupil composed of countless swirling nebulae, so profound it seemed to contain the rise and fall of an entire universe. This was no life form of any shape, but a consciousness collective transcending physical form—the materialization and holy manifestation of the Heavenly Dao itself. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining visibly—five points, ten points, fifteen points...

dialogue.content: 【Chen Ji】(Enduring the agony, a cold smirk forming at the corner of his mouth) Three hundred years? Such patience, senior. Unfortunately, Chen has never believed in fate, nor in any chess game arranged by the Heavenly Dao.

text.content: The Eye of the Heavenly Dao's pupil slightly contracted, as if amused by this ant-like existence. A stream of information was directly poured into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—that was the prophetic vision of Chapter Seven Hundred. There he saw himself lying in a pool of blood, the assassin's face shrouded in the mist of fate. Now, that mist was dissipating, revealing a truth that made Chen Ji's liver and gallbladder quake.

dialogue.content: 【The Eye of the Heavenly Dao】See clearly now, successor? The assassin in the prophecy was never a particular individual—it was an ending I personally authored. Every time you use the Tianji Record, you take one step closer to that ending.

text.content: Chen Ji stared intently at the gradually clarifying image in his Mental Sea: the figure lying in blood was indeed himself, but the fatal wound's location... three cun to the left of the heart, precisely his only weakness after cultivating the Heart-Protecting Art. This was a vulnerability only someone extremely close would know. And in the image, the hand gripping the dagger was slender, fair, with a birthmark on the wrist that Chen Ji recognized more intimately than anything—the hand of Chen Nian.

dialogue.content: 【Chen Ji】(His pupils contracting sharply, yet his voice becoming terrifyingly calm) How interesting. The Heavenly Dao's methods are indeed extraordinary—having an elder brother killed by his own sister. This cruelty indeed befits the四个字 'Heavenly Dao is merciless'.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment erupted with dazzling golden light, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifesting a phantom shadow, shielding Chen Ji. 'Enough!' The aged voice carried three hundred years of resentment, 'The successor of the Tianji Record is not a plaything for you to knead at will!' The Eye of the Heavenly Dao's gaze made Mo Xiansheng's phantom shudder violently, yet he still stood with a straight spine.

choice.prompt: The Eye of the Heavenly Dao's pressure was tangible, the entire Three Realms trembling beneath its gaze. Faced with this existence transcending all, Chen Ji must respond—

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Dao wishes to play, then stake everything. The War of Fate, I, Chen Ji, accept—but I want to witness your expression when you lose.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain War of Fate Challenger Identity
choices.risk_hint: May Fall Directly into the Heavenly Dao's Scheme
choices.process_label: 陈机挺直脊背，迎上天道之眼的注视

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the suffocating vision in his Mental Sea. When he raised his head again, his eyes were already ice-cold. 'Fine.' His voice echoed through the void, 'Chen has lived twenty-three years and has never bowed his head to anyone—including the Heavenly Dao.'

dialogue.content: 【The Eye of the Heavenly Dao】(The nebulae in the pupil suddenly accelerated their rotation) Interesting. In three hundred years, the first ant to dare look directly at me and say 'fine'. I will await your struggles in the War of Fate.

choices.description: You keep claiming I am bound by fate, yet never explain—why was I chosen? How much more does the Eye of the Heavenly Dao still conceal about the secrets of the Tianji Record Fragment?
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao May Choose Direct Annihilation
choices.process_label: 陈机眯起眼睛，决定试探这庞然大物的底线

text.content: Chen Ji was not devoured by fear; instead, beneath this world-shattering pressure, he calmly began to analyze. He spoke slowly, each word like a blade: "Every prophet throughout history has been your chess piece, and the Tianji Record is merely a tool to gather the threads of destiny. But you chose me—a servant disciple with a废物 physique—as your successor? That in itself is a flaw."

dialogue.content: 【Eye of Heavenly Way】(After a moment of silence, a trace of... approval flickered in those nebula pupils?) You are closer to the truth than any successor before. Yes, you were not chosen—you were... created. One hundred and thirty-seven years ago, this seat required a vessel capable of bearing the full burden of the Tianji Record, and you... survived by chance in an experiment of destiny.

choices.description: Destiny is mine, not Heaven's! Even if you are Heavenly Way, I will tear apart this scripted play—Tianji Record, grant me power!
choices.process_label: 陈机体内天机录符文疯狂燃烧，他选择了最激进的应对

text.content: Chen Ji erupted violently, the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm exploding with blinding golden light. He bit through his tongue and sprayed essence blood onto the pages—a forbidden technique that cost one's life. In an instant, he felt his connection to the Tianji Record amplified a thousandfold, and a force capable of shaking stars surged forth from within his body.

dialogue.content: 【Eye of Heavenly Way】(The nebula pupils suddenly contracted) Presumptuous! Yet a flicker crossed those nebula-formed eyes—this ant's rebellious will is more... delicious than anticipated.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a agonized roar within the golden light, but he did not retreat. "Chen Ji!" His voice arrived as if from an extremely distant past, "Whatever choice you make, don't forget—the true power of the Tianji Record lies not in foresight, but in..." Before he could finish, a thunderbolt descended from the Eye of Heavenly Way, shattering most of Mo Xiansheng's ethereal form.

【Chen Ji】(A cold light flickering in his eyes) In what? Speak! Old thing, how many secrets are you still hiding?! However, the only response was a line of golden text newly appearing on the Tianji Record Fragment—the information Mo Xiansheng left with his final breath: "Lies in rewriting."

The Eye of Heavenly Way's gaze grew increasingly solid, as if wanting to see through Chen Ji's soul. "Rewrite?" The transcendent voice carried a hint of mockery, "A mere vessel dares to covet Heavenly Principles? This seat will show you a fact—all your efforts have been within the script. You plot across the world, your calculations flawless, but have you ever considered that the people you schemed against were themselves chess pieces arranged by this seat?"

dialogue.content: 【Eye of Heavenly Way】Su Qingyao's investigation, Ling Yuan's ambition, Ye Qing's betrayal, even your sister Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect—all of this was this seat's elaborate arrangement to propel you onto the stage of the battle for destiny. You think you are rebelling, but every one of your acts of rebellion is performed according to the script this seat has written.

text.content: Chen Ji's fist clenched violently. Fingernails pierced into his palm, blood dripping between his fingers. At this moment, he felt an unprecedented chill—not fear of Heavenly Way, but doubt about the meaning of his own existence. If everything was prearranged, then what did his years of struggle, scheming, and endurance amount to?

However, just as his spiritual heart was about to collapse, a spiritual insight flashed through Chen Ji's mind. He recalled the "accidents" in his schemes—the inexplicable turns when Su Qingyao nearly saw through him; the moment Ye Qing could have betrayed him but chose to trust instead; and Chen Nian turning to look at him in the crowd before being taken, that gaze that belonged to no script.

choice.prompt: Facing Heavenly Way's declaration that "everything is a script," cracks appeared in Chen Ji's spiritual heart. Yet, something always made him feel something was wrong—

choices.description: The script is yours to write, but actors have their own will. I don't believe your "arrangement" can be precise down to every gaze, every heartbeat—that's not a chess game, that's you bluffing.
choices.process_label: 陈机深吸一口气，在识海中重建自己的信念

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes. When he opened them again, that familiar calm and calculation had returned to his pupils. "You're right, Senior." His voice was terrifyingly calm, "If everything of mine is a script, then tell me—your revealing this to me now, is that also within the script? You're afraid—afraid I've found the loopholes in the script."

dialogue.content: 【Eye of Heavenly Way】(The nebula in the pupils came to an abrupt halt for a moment)... Interesting. This seat has waited three hundred years for precisely this moment—a chess piece daring to question the script. The battle of destiny will commence in Chapter 1155, when this seat will personally witness how you use "the actor's will" to oppose the author's iron pen.

choices.description: Since the battle of destiny is inevitable, then before that, I need to know—what do you truly want? Tell me the price directly, perhaps we can negotiate a deal.
choices.risk_hint: May Be Manipulated by the Heavenly Dao
choices.process_label: 陈机决定暂时收起锋芒，尝试与天道进行某种交易

text.content: Chen Ji did not continue to resist, but instead chose another strategy. He stared directly into that vast eye, his voice steady: "Senior Heavenly Dao, master of the laws governing the Three Realms, surely You wouldn't be so bored as to personally descend just to mock an ant. Your presence must mean You have schemes in mind. Speak directly - in this battle of destiny, what must I sacrifice, and what can I gain?"

dialogue.content: 【Eye of Heavenly Dao】(A laughter like cosmic resonance echoes forth) Clever. This One enjoys dealing with the clever. The price is simple - if you win, you rewrite the laws of the Heavenly Dao; if you lose, you become the next "raw material" for the Tianji Record. As for your sister... she shall be the most crucial variable in this war.

text.content: Chen Nian's name was like a blade, stabbing ruthlessly into the softest part of Chen Ji's Dao heart. His sister, missing for years, whom he considered his greatest weakness - how could the Heavenly Dao link her to the battle of destiny? Is this a threat, or... does it hold deeper meaning? On the Tianji Record Fragment, the four characters left by Mo Xiansheng - "lies in rewriting" - flickered once more, as if hinting at something.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao slowly closed, leaving only a low Dao tone reverberating through the Void: "Twenty-four chapters later, the battle of destiny begins.届时，三界英杰皆为你的对手，而你的筹码，仅有那一页残缺的天机录，以及……不甘被命运摆布的意志。" That voice gradually faded, yet the final words burned like thunder into the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea - "This One has waited three hundred years, not for a battle of victory or defeat, but for a... variable."
